title: The 4 Best Car Seats for Travel
h1: The 4 Best Car Seats for Travel
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for car seats for travel, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at car seats for travel using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Evenflo LiteMax 35 Infant Car Seat
products.blurb: Key specs: 8.7-pound carrier shell, Fits infants 4 to 35 pounds, Belt lock-off for base-free installation.
strengths: Lightest carrier in this list, a real difference when carrying it through an airport terminal
Belt lock-off means it installs securely in a rental car without needing to bring or check the base
Typically the least expensive seat here, lowering the stakes if travel handling causes wear
limitations: Still needs to be checked or gate-checked without a base, since the base itself is bulky to travel with
Fewer premium comfort features than the pricier picks
Height limit means it will not last as long for an older, taller toddler

products.name: Chicco KeyFit 35 Infant Car Seat
products.blurb: Key specs: Fits infants 4 to 35 pounds, FAA-approved for aircraft use, Belt path routing built into the shell for base-free installs.
strengths: Belt path routing on the shell itself means the seat installs without its base in a rental car
Widely reported as producing a correct install on the first try, useful when rushed at an airport counter
If you already own this seat at home, bringing the same one keeps install muscle memory consistent
limitations: Heavier carrier than the LiteMax 35, more tiring across a long terminal walk
Base is not practical to bring along, so travel means base-free belt installs only
Height limit around 30 inches limits how long it works for an older child
features: Belt path routing built into the shell for base-free installs
Level indicator for accurate recline angle

products.name: Evenflo Sonus Convertible Car Seat
strengths: Light and easy to move between cars
Budget price for a convertible seat
Compact enough for smaller back seats
limitations: Less legroom rear-facing than extended-legroom seats

products.name: Graco Contender Slim Convertible Car Seat

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
